title: NAPCC National Mission On Strategic Knowledge For Climate Change
definition: One of the eight core missions under the National Action Plan on Climate Change (NAPCC), aimed at identifying challenges, fostering research, and building a robust knowledge system to address climate change impacts in India.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested in the context of India's climate policy architecture, institutional capacity building, and the intersection of science, technology, and policy-making.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of NAPCC National Mission On Strategic Knowledge For Climate Change.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Knowledge of India's NDCs under the Paris Agreement
